      - 'formal/lean/lake-manifest.json'
      - '.github/workflows/p104-affine-complement-lean.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  formal:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97

          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Checksum-pinned official Lean
        shell: bash
        run: |
          curl --fail --location --retry 3 https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/releases/download/v4.21.0/lean-4.21.0-linux.tar.zst -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/p104-lean.tar.zst"
          echo "455c6df09d5bd54d2a51b137939c47e2dda816d512ac789c4b3642c9bf98bde8  $RUNNER_TEMP/p104-lean.tar.zst" | sha256sum --check
          tar --zstd -xf "$RUNNER_TEMP/p104-lean.tar.zst" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/lean-4.21.0-linux/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Provision pinned Mathlib modules
        working-directory: formal/lean
        run: lake exe cache get Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dual.Lemmas Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod Mathlib.Data.Finset.Card
      - name: Fresh kernel proof and rejecting controls
        run: python -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-affine-complement-lean/check_lean.py
      - run: git diff --exit-code
remaining: Full substantive review remains open.

head: 9f0c00d353b521c6840729861e48d7d0da20d345
source:
name: Classical matrix boundary with signed554 T74

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'research/t74-signed554-phase-fusion/**'
      - '.github/workflows/t74-signed554-phase-fusion.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main, codex/t74-signed554-phase-fusion-20261014]
    paths:
      - 'research/t74-signed554-phase-fusion/**'
      - '.github/workflows/t74-signed554-phase-fusion.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python: ['3.11', '3.14']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7, retained repository pin
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7, retained repository pin
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}
      - name: Install retained cold-replay dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends g++ libboost-dev
          python -m pip install -r research/t74-signed554-phase-fusion/requirements.txt
      - name: Fresh ancestry, supplier, owner construction and strict admission
        env:
          CXX: g++
          BOOST_INCLUDE: /usr/include
        run: >-
          python -B research/t74-signed554-phase-fusion/verify.py
          --work "$RUNNER_TEMP/signed554-fusion-cold"
      - name: Require committed sources unchanged
        if: always()
        run: git diff --exit-code
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: signed554-fusion-python-${{ matrix.python }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/signed554-fusion-cold/*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/signed554-fusion-cold/*.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/signed554-fusion-cold/strict/*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/signed554-fusion-cold/strict/*.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/signed554-fusion-cold/strict/global/audit/*.json
remaining: Resolve the inherited T74/#1319 supplier admission (controller, geometry, invoice and semantic regenerated-artifact checks) before accepting a stronger bound. Independently audit the new outer schedule/analytic cost argument and its precision, movement and recurrence interfaces; parameter inequalities alone do not establish it.
